body:
Shall we have a requirement about MFA fatigue attack / MFA bombing / MFA spamming?

Related discussion https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/2618#issuecomment-2738501140

comments.body:
We have

> V2.7.8 Verify that, where push notifications are used for multi-factor authentication, rate limiting or number matching is used to prevent push bombing attacks.

And more actractly
> V11.2.2 Verify that anti-automation controls are in place to protect against excessive calls to application functions that could lead to data exfiltration, garbage data creation, quota exhaustion, rate limit breaches, denial of service, or overuse of costly resources.
Is there any action or propose to wait (to modify existing ones) or we can close this out?
Yes, I think that should be enough, sorry. I think we can close this one.

labels.name: 2) Awaiting response

title: Add requirement about MFA fatigue attack / MFA bombing / MFA spamming
